subject: session date
fact: The session occurs on the 5th day of the 2nd Tenday of Taraskh 1493 DR.
source_quote: On the 5th day of the 2nd Tenday of Taraskh 1493

subject: elapsed time
fact: An hour passes between two events in the session.
source_quote: An hour later

subject: chasme count
fact: Four chasme demons are present in the cavern above the prisoners' tower.
source_quote: four chasme and two vrock

subject: travel to Sloobludop
fact: Sloobludop is approximately eight days away via the Darklake.
source_quote: the town of Sloopdopblop is just eight days away

subject: Velkynvelve elevation
fact: Velkynvelve sits 100 feet above the cavern floor.
source_quote: Drow outpost was 100' in the sky

subject: silver candlestick value
fact: The silver candlesticks flanking the Lolth altar are worth 25 gp each.
source_quote: a pair of heavy silver candlesticks worth 25 gp each

subject: psychic manifestation of 'Sacrifice! Power! For the Big Baboon Demon!'
fact: Plinki's mind emitted a screeching, red mess of 'Sacrifice! Power! For the Big Baboon Demon!'
source_quote: Plinki, her mind was just a screeching, red mess of "Sacrifice! Power! For the Big Baboon Demon!"

subject: psychic manifestation of 'AAAAH-PAIN!'
fact: Eldeth's thoughts went *AAAAH-PAIN!* like gEttin g stabbed with a rusty-tasting needle
source_quote: the nice lady-dwarf, Eldeth, her thoughts just went *AAAAH-PAIN!* and it was like gEttin g stabbed with a rusty-tasting needle!

subject: psychic manifestation of 'Maximilian's Earthen Grasp'
fact: Daz, the clever Drow, said, "Maximilian's Earthen Grasp," and the ground just reached up with a big muddy thought and *SQUEEZED* the eye-thing!
source_quote: Daz, the clever Drow, his thoughts are like a spiderweb, all intricate and patient. He said, "Maximilian's Earthen Grasp," and the ground just reached up with a big muddy thought and *SQUEEZED* the eye-thing!

subject: psychic manifestation of 'The leader is the lynchpin. Neutralize Plinki.'
fact: Zalthir thought, "The leader is the lynchpin. Neutralize Plinki." and then opened his mouth and the thought turned into ROARING-HOT-AGONY-FIRE!
source_quote: I heard him think, "The leader is the lynchpin. Neutralize Plinki." And then he opened his mouth and the thought turned into ROARING-HOT-AGONY-FIRE!

subject: psychic manifestation of 'This one is the most dangerous. Their skill is a threat.'
fact: Zalthir thought, "This one is the most dangerous. Their skill is a threat." and he just... grabbed the thief-derro!
source_quote: I heard him think, "This one is the most dangerous. Their skill is a threat." and he just... grabbed the thief-derro!

subject: psychic manifestation of 'What-?!'
fact: The thief's surprise was a sharp, lemon-zest tang of "What-?!"
source_quote: The thief's surprise was a sharp, lemon-zest tang of "What-?!"

subject: psychic manifestation of 'Get it, get it, get it, get out!'
fact: Daz's thoughts screamed, "Get it, get it, get it, get out!"
source_quote: "Get it, get it, get it, get out!" his thoughts screamed.

subject: psychic manifestation of 'WHERE IS THE EGG?! THE EGG! WHO HAS THE EGG?!'
fact: All the other derro felt it at once! Their minds exploded in a chorus of "WHERE IS THE EGG?! THE EGG! WHO HAS THE EGG?!"
source_quote: And all the other derro felt it at once! Their minds exploded in a chorus of "WHERE IS THE EGG?! THE EGG! WHO HAS THE EGG?!"

subject: psychic manifestation of 'This one is off-balance. Strike here.'
fact: Zalthir thought, "This one is off-balance. Strike here." And then, *whump*, another one gone.
source_quote: Zalthir was like, "This one is off-balance. Strike here." And then, *whump*, another one gone.

subject: psychic manifestation of 'The thief's mind was like a fortress and just pushed him out!'
fact: The thief's mind was like a fortress and just pushed [Pelek] out!
source_quote: The thief's mind was like a fortress and just pushed him out!

subject: Daz's psychic departure from the egg
fact: Daz went all silvery and wasn't there anymore; he was by the egg, and the anxiety coming off him was a physical wave.
source_quote: The wizard, Daz, his mind went all silvery and he just... wasn't there anymore! A little psychic *poof* and then he was by the egg, and the anxiety coming off him was a physical wave!

subject: Pelek's failed psychic intrusion into the thief
fact: Pelek tried to get in the thief's head! It was like trying to pour hot tea and cold water into the same cup, all sizzle and steam and wrongness!
source_quote: And the poor ghost, Pelek, he tried to get in the thief's head! It was like trying to pour hot tea and cold water into the same cup, all sizzle and steam and wrongness!

subject: Zalthir's methodical dismantling of the thief
fact: It was just... *thud, thud, thud.* No anger, no rage, just... methodical dismantling.
source_quote: It was just... *thud, thud, thud.* No anger, no rage, just... methodical dismantling.

subject: Zalthir's final thought pattern
fact: Zalthir moved so fast! I heard him think, "This one is the most dangerous. Their skill is a threat." and he just... grabbed the thief-derro!
source_quote: I heard him think, "This one is the most dangerous. Their skill is a threat." and he just... grabbed the thief-derro!
